changelog:
Major update: Adds structured quantity extraction from IFC/Revit models, grouped reporting, and Python API.

- Automated extraction of counts, areas, volumes, lengths, and weights from BIM models (IFC, Revit, DWG).
- Supports grouping and reporting by type, level, and zone.
- Includes command line tools for model-to-Excel conversion.
- Provides a Python API for loading, processing, and aggregating BIM quantity data.
- Documentation expanded with business case, pipeline diagrams, and code samples.
summary: Extract quantities from IFC/Revit models for quantity takeoff. Uses DDC converters to get element counts, areas, volumes, lengths with grouping and reporting.
